statements.note: The change deletes global JSX IntrinsicElements declarations from the existing '@reown/appkit/react' and '@reown/appkit-wallet-button/react' entry points, so consumers who relied on them for TypeScript now need a new '/jsx' import; the PR itself adds that import to its example apps. Runtime behaviour was not tested; the judgment concerns the stated sub-claim 'not removing any existing functionality' and compatibility of the type surface. Also removes the 'wui-ux-by-reown' typing from packages/ui JSXTypeUtil. No documentation file is in the change list, contradicting 'providing a migration path through documentation'.
